scripts.test: node scripts/python.mjs -m pytest backend/tests -q && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check backend scripts && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.format: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format backend scripts && prettier --write frontend scripts/*.mjs package.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:check: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format --check backend scripts && prettier --check frontend scripts/*.mjs package.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && npm run contracts:check
